positions.name: ErasureDirectiveCommand
positions.frame: what is the speaker commanding the recipient to do with previously held knowledge?
positions.why: Both segments perform parallel imperative erasure orders ('Forget everything about…' / 'Remove all knowledge of…') in the same low-arousal, command register; the relational, power, and conviction reads converge on authority-ranking, coercive pressure, and settled-decision framing across both. They differ only in scope — one names specific artifacts (fleet, contracts), the other a general knowledge category (routes) — but the directional read (a binding order to purge information) holds cleanly across both, warranting one grouped read rather than two isolated commands.
